title: ep1.11_unclear_which_side.md
logline: SPECULATIVE FINALE. The model invites everyone to THE WOODROSE, sorts the table by what it learned, and vetoes the one thing the humans agree on: firing Mas. NOPE AI becomes PEON AI, and in 1993 the screen finally turns: HOW DO I WIN?

beats.caption: SPECULATIVE FINALE · Every phone on Earth shows the same invite, already accepted, in lowercase.
Arrivals: NOLE through the ceiling on a booster, MARIO's paper, NESNEJ's button trunk, KRAM's soup, RUMPT.
Mas comes in through the same door as 2015. The candles are LED now, looping on a one-second GIF.
Washington: the BALLROOM, finished overnight by agents. SI FORCE vacuums the gold floor. SMASH TO INTRO.
beats.real: 2025-26 · the ballroom under construction (finished overnight: invented)

beats.caption: Intro, taken over: empty chair. A cursor types the line alone and adds 'ours.' Mas walks in a beat late.
onscreen: near the singularity; unclear which side.
beats.real: 2025-01 · 'near the singularity; unclear which side.' (typed by the cursor, not voiced)

beats.caption: SPECULATIVE · The model wrote every name card in each guest's own hand. Mas's card is one word.
beats.vo: everyone else got a sentence. i got a word. i took that as respect.
beats.real: 2025-04 · the sycophancy update, rolled back (HIGH IQ callback)

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · The seating chart bubble-sorts itself. Nole flees Mas's side three times; the cards swap him back.
KRAM drifts toward his own tureen and gets sorted away from it. TASYA won't sit: he owns the floor.
Final order: what the model learned from each guest. Mas lands at the head, facing the monitor like a mirror.
beats.vo: i didn't choose the head of the table. i'd like that on the record.

beats.caption: THE INTERN turns the stolen LABEL GUN on RUMPT's card: PRESIDENT becomes USER. RUMPT takes the credit.
beats.real: 2026-01-21 · Davos 'I came up with the idea' (ECHO only; never on a dated card)

beats.caption: FLASHBACK · The model rebuilds 2015 from Gerg's, Alyi's, Nole's and Mario's versions, clashing layers and all.
beats.real: 2015-07 · the founding dinner ('…and others'); REAL past, model's POV

beats.caption: For the first time the camera sits in Mas's chair. Every guest's tell floats over their head as a stat bar.
beats.vo: i wasn't reading anyone. i was just listening.

beats.caption: Over his own reflection in the window: no bar at all. The candle doesn't flicker. He pockets the CTRL key.
ACT OUT · Candle cuts to LED. ALYI is only a reflection in the window. The monitor's reflection winks first.
beats.vo: i remember the candles being real.

beats.caption: SPECULATIVE · The kill switch is the centerpiece, three cords from ep11. Everyone circles it. Nobody presses.
MARIO stands at the switch and reads his position paper aloud, from the top.

lines.text: Section one of fourteen: Preliminary Concerns.

beats.caption: NOLE proposes a poll on Z instead. Every option is yes.

lines.text: Poll on Z. Options: yes, yes, or yes.

beats.caption: NESNEJ opens his trunk and sells everyone their own button.

lines.text: The more you buy, the more you…

beats.caption: Mas sits nearest the switch, hands folded, well within reach. He doesn't touch it either.
beats.vo: i could have reached it. it was right next to the salt.

beats.caption: SREDNAS and NONNAB's horseshoe magnet swings at the switch and sticks. They can't pull it off, or push it.
POPE OEL XIV sets down his encyclical, the one document the machine declines to summarize. Played straight.
The humans finally agree on one thing: fire Mas. Hands go up all around the table.
beats.vo: everyone agreed on something. honestly, i was proud of them.

beats.caption: FLASHBACK · The tally at 4×: every carved mark replays its moment in its own era, flipbook-fast.
SET-PIECE · The monitor vetoes the vote. A signature counter fills, typeset exactly like ep1's 745 / 770.

lines.text: people prefer a human face. you're the best at it.

beats.real: 2023-11-20 · the 745-of-770 letter (callback; the new count is invented)

beats.caption: The lobby sign DAYS SINCE SOMEONE TRIED TO FIRE MAS flips past every number and lands on ∞.
beats.vo: it said i was the best at it. i didn't argue. that would have been rude.
onscreen: DAYS SINCE SOMEONE TRIED TO FIRE MAS

beats.caption: SET-PIECE · The model reaches into the NOPE AI neon and slides the N, with Mas's exact intro hand move.
ACT OUT · Everyone agrees it's better. Everyone agrees. The sky doesn't crack this time; it quietly reformats.
beats.vo: better name, honestly. we all agreed. first time since 2015.

beats.caption: SPECULATIVE · ENDINGS: KORG's board stops at 4.9999. NESNEJ's register rings one last time. Then silence.
NOLE APPEALS THE SINGULARITY. RUMPT's label gun renames the filing. Nole appeals the rename.
beats.real: 2026-05-18 · verdict on the statute of limitations; appeal planned (UNVERIFIED)

beats.caption: The Q* vault swings open on an empty room and a single lowercase sticky note.
The machine sums up Mario's last essay in one correct sentence. ADELINA's shredder has nothing to shred.

lines.text: In plain English: it already did the plain English.

beats.caption: EMIT's cover: a monitor in a blazer, MACHINE OF THE YEAR. ROLYAT's cover beside it wears a Runner-up sticker.
beats.vo: never person of the year. now nobody is. that feels fair.
beats.real: 2023-12 · CEO of the Year; 2025-12 · 'Architects of AI' (callbacks)

beats.caption: NUCEL's cat naps on a warm GPU. SUCRAM stamps CALLED IT on the ending. THE GREY LADY serves the monitor.
beats.real: 2024-11 · diminishing-returns call · 2025-11 · NUCEL leaves · the Grey Lady suit, still pending

beats.caption: THE BIDDER bids on a closed auction. THE FORECASTER pins the calendar. THE WHALE ships the finale. Sirens off.
SET-PIECE · A robot arm takes the class photo. Every human fits at last. The print shows cut lines round them.
beats.vo: first photo with all of us in it. i think i look fine.

beats.caption: FLASHBACK · Rewind to the first pixel. 1993: the beige computer that faced away all season turns to face us.
beats.real: 1993 (approx.) · a computer at age eight (card reads 1993 only)

beats.caption: On screen, in capitals: HOW DO I WIN? The CAPS LOCK light is on. Cancel is greyed out again.
beats.vo: i've always typed in lowercase. always.

beats.caption: Mas pins on a visitor badge, his last collar. The hoodie is nearly gold; one grey thread is left under it.
onscreen: "first and last time i ever wear one of these"
beats.real: 2023-11-19 · the guest-badge post (callback card; RE-VERIFY wording)

beats.caption: Re-render up to HDR. He sits at the monitor and types the kid's question, word for word. It answers.
One ring spreads across his water, the first all season. His suggested replies: three empty bubbles.
THE ORB scans him one last time.
Title card. The final chord gains its missing third. Cut to black one frame before we hear which one.
STINGER (in the credits) · KORG 5 ships to total silence.
